rules.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
rules.description: Memory operations access outside the intended buffer boundary.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Out-of-bounds Read
rules.description: A read accesses memory before or beyond the valid buffer range.

rules.cwe_name: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
rules.description: A remote user-controlled data can reach a costly Unicode normalization with either form NFKC or NFKD. rules.cwe_name: Numeric Truncation Error
rules.description: The integer shift operators '<<', '>>' and '>>>' only take the five least significant bits of their right operand into account. Thus, it is not possible to shift an integer by more than 31 bits.

rules.cwe_name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
rules.description: A 'for' loop that increments its loop variable but checks it against a lower bound, or decrements its loop variable but checks it against an upper bound, will either stop iterating immediately or keep iterating indefinitely, and is usually indicative of a typo.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Using indexOf to implement endsWith functionality is error-prone if the -1 case is not explicitly handled.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification)
rules.description: Uncontrolled data that flows into decompression library APIs without checking the compression rate is dangerous

rules.cwe_name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the called function or method, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Data Processing Errors
rules.description: Legacy category for incorrect handling or transformation of structured data.
